apps.name: Key Mapper
apps.summary: Remap hardware buttons and key combinations.
apps.curatorNote: A useful companion for configuring hardware controls. It needs accessibility permissions for some remapping features.

apps.name: Vela
apps.summary: Offline maps and turn-by-turn navigation without Google Play Services.
apps.curatorNote: A privacy-focused map app with direct APK releases. D-pad navigation should be tested on the target device.

apps.name: DPAD Messaging
apps.summary: A messaging app designed for dumbphones with D-pad navigation.
apps.curatorNote: Built specifically for keypad phones, with D-pad and accessibility improvements in the latest release.

apps.name: D-PAD Player
apps.summary: A lightweight local music player for dumbphones.
apps.curatorNote: Designed around D-pad navigation with a direct APK available in each release.

apps.name: DumberKit: Phone
apps.summary: A keypad-friendly phone app for dialing, call history, and incoming calls.
apps.curatorNote: Built for keypad phones and intended to be operated with the physical keys alone.

apps.name: DumberKit: Contacts
apps.summary: A contacts app designed for keypad phones with D-pad and T9 support.
apps.curatorNote: Every screen, menu, and dialog is designed for D-pad and keypad operation.

apps.name: DumberKit: Clock
apps.summary: A keypad-friendly clock, alarm, stopwatch, and timer.
apps.curatorNote: Designed for physical-key operation, including alarm and timer controls.

apps.name: DumberKit: Calculator
apps.summary: A keypad calculator and unit converter for dumbphones.
apps.curatorNote: Calculations are entered directly from the keypad, with D-pad navigation across screens.

apps.name: MiniSpot
apps.summary: A minimal Spotify client optimized for dumbphones.
apps.curatorNote: Designed for keypad phones with a direct APK release. Requires a Spotify Premium account; login setup may require the included PC helper.

apps.name: inkOS
apps.curatorNote: A launcher designed for simple, readable operation on e-ink and low-distraction devices. The Dumber Mini app wiki lists it as compatible with full keypad support.

apps.name: MatChat
apps.summary: End-to-end encrypted Matrix messaging for D-pad feature phones.
apps.curatorNote: A D-pad-first Matrix client for locked-down Android feature phones.

apps.name: FlipCalendar
apps.summary: A D-pad calendar for de-Googled flip phones.
apps.curatorNote: A native calendar that syncs with Google Calendar without Google Play Services.

apps.name: NovaLox
apps.summary: D-pad messaging with SMS and MMS support for keypad phones.
apps.curatorNote: A privacy-focused messaging app designed for flip phones and physical-key operation.

apps.name: Authenticator
apps.curatorNote: An offline D-pad compatible 2FA (TOTP) app. Codes are stored encrypted with an optional password lock

apps.name: TT9 (Offline Voice)
apps.summary: T9 keyboard for keypad phones with offline voice typing using Whistle.
apps.curatorNote: A build of the TT9 keyboard with offline speech-to-text. Releases include lite and full APKs; the keyboard must be enabled in system settings after install.

apps.name: QUIK (D-pad)
apps.summary: QUIK SMS messenger patched with full D-pad and keypad navigation.
apps.curatorNote: Upstream QUIK with a D-pad patch set applied and published as signed APK releases.
